applies_why: The judge text does not ground UNDERDETERMINED on a single verse failing to state a link or its contrary; it grounds it on the defender's dropped curse limb leaving no live link to contradict.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: "a single verse does not state a link or its contrary": (1) it bars only a ruling grounded on a verse's silence; (2) it bars any underdetermined ruling involving a verse
why: The judge's stated reason is the dropped live link, not a verse's failure to state the link or contrary, so K-S2 does not forbid this UNDERDETERMINED.
